api_key.description: Tenant ID and Access Policy Token (or API key) for Grafana Cloud in the format '<tenant-id>:<token-or-api-key>'. May alternatively be set via the `GRAFANA_AM_API_KEY` environment variable.

debug.description: Whether to enable debug logging. Defaults to false.

http_headers.description: HTTP headers mapping keys to values used for accessing Grafana Cloud APIs. May alternatively be set via the `GRAFANA_AM_HTTP_HEADERS` environment variable in JSON format.

retries.description: The amount of retries to use for Grafana API and Grafana Cloud API calls. Defaults to 3. May alternatively be set via the `GRAFANA_AM_RETRIES` environment variable.

url.description: Grafana Cloud's API URL. May alternatively be set via the `GRAFANA_AM_API_URL` environment variable.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of when this exemption was created.

disable_recommendations.description: When set to true, the recommendations service will exempt this metric from consideration.

id.description: A UILD that uniquely identifies the exemption.

keep_labels.description: The array of labels to keep; labels not in this array will be aggregated.

metric.description: The name of the metric to be aggregated.

reason.description: An optional string detailing the reason(s) for this exemption.

segment.description: The id of the segment to create an exemption for.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp of when this exemption was last updated.

id.description: A ULID that uniquely identifies the policy.

min_query_usages.description: The minimum number of query usages required for a metric to be considered for recommendations.

unused_metrics_action.description: The action to take for metrics with no recorded usage. Valid values are: drop_all_labels, drop_custom_labels, keep_custom_labels, best_guess.

unused_metrics_action_act_on_custom_labe.description: The list of custom labels to act on when unused_metrics_action is drop_custom_labels or keep_custom_labels.

usage_sources.description: The sources of usage data to consider when generating recommendations. Valid values are: dashboard, rules, queries.

block.description: A policy defines the configuration for Adaptive Metrics recommendations generation. Policies can be assigned to segments to customize recommendation behavior.

aggregation_interval.description: The interval at which to generate the aggregated series.

aggregations.description: The array of aggregation types to calculate for this metric.

auto_import.description: When set to true, the rule will be automatically imported if it is not already in Terraform state.

drop.description: Set to true to skip both ingestion and aggregation and drop the metric entirely.

drop_labels.description: The array of labels that will be aggregated.

segment.description: The name of the segment to aggregate metrics for.

fallback_to_default.description: Whether to fallback to the default segment if the selector does not match any segments.

id.description: A ULID that uniquely identifies the segment.

selector.description: The selector that defines the segment.

action.description: Limit the types of recommended actions to list. Valid recommended actions are 'add', 'remove', 'keep', and 'update'. Defaults to listing all actions.

recommended_action.description: The recommended action for the aggregation rule.

total_series_after_aggregation.description: The total number of series after aggregation.

total_series_before_aggregation.description: The total number of series before aggregation.

usages_in_dashboards.description: The number of dashboards that use this metric.

usages_in_queries.description: The number of queries that use this metric..

usages_in_rules.description: The number of rules that use this metric.
